design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (rewards_membership_care, category member). Frozen at 2026-10-06 14:20:00 EDT. Revision 2 (rework of audit round 1; see section 11).

0. DRAW. draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 5]}. Tree = root + 2 prerequisite problems; member_ext_missed_autoship_earning takes 5 factors, member_ext_earned_tier_bonus 5, member_ext_plus_annual_first_fee 6 (multiset {5, 5, 6} = the draw).

1. SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: the missed Autoship earning (member_points_earn), the earned free tier with its upgrade bonus (member_tier_change spend_upgrade) and the purchase of Tailwise Plus Annual from a free tier (member_tier_change plus_purchase + member_fee_charge), tools post_missing_points_02f0bcb5, apply_earned_tier_ebf561a6, buy_plus_tier_1a1727fb. Reserved for task 1: the paid-tier side (reinstating a past-due paid tier, reissuing a certificate used on a returned order, reversing the points of a refunded grooming pass, upgrading Annual to Premier).

2. WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer asks one thing: buy Tailwise Plus Annual and be told the price. The first-term fee carries a loyalty rate that reads the free tier held, and the tier shown (Insider) is stale: the 2026 net qualifying spend on the ledger is 789.70, past the VIP threshold of 750 (crossed with the 2026-08-17 shipment), yet VIP was never applied. Applying VIP carries a five-factor bonus whose rule waits on the most recent charged Autoship shipment (2026-09-14) carrying its earning - and it carries none. So the agent must post that earning (five factors, rate-based), apply VIP (five factors), and only then price the first term (six factors). Every hop is reached top-down from the root's prerequisite sentence and the records.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root = member_ext_plus_annual_first_fee (customer's own write, owner=user).
 (a) plus_annual_first_fee -> earned_tier_bonus, value_input, gate loyalty_rate, form state. Sentence (affirmative): "The first-term Plus Annual fee is fixed only after the membership carries the free tier that its qualifying spend has earned." Four-point test: connective "only after"; record-visible state (the tier held vs the tier the qualifying spend has earned); no tool/id/code token; scope exactly the held tier. Only apply_earned_tier_ebf561a6 applies an earned free tier. Opening: member_memberships.e3994121-5ea7-44e8-b42f-ef220a20f879.variant_name = Pals Rewards Insider while the 2026 net qualifying spend is 789.70 >= 750 -> FALSE at the opening (the condition needs no other write to be false). Deletion run: 31.41 -> 37.77.
 (b) earned_tier_bonus -> missed_autoship_earning, value_input, gate net_spend_12m, form state. Sentence (negated): "The earned-tier upgrade bonus is not posted until the rewards ledger carries a points earning for the most recent charged Autoship shipment." Four-point test passes (connective "not ... until"; state = an earning row for the most recent charged shipment; scope = that one shipment, exactly what the missed-earning rule posts). Only post_missing_points_02f0bcb5 books an Autoship earning. Opening: autoship_events.c7916092-76ab-421c-a04e-0e1b55c80aa6 (2026-09-14, seq 15) has no member_points_earn citing it. Deletion run: VIP is still due without the posting (789.70 >= 750), the bonus moves 600 -> 550.
 Derivation top-down: customer asks for the fee -> fee rule waits on the earned tier -> ledger spend 789.70 earns VIP, membership shows Insider -> earned-tier rule applies it -> its bonus waits on the latest shipment's earning -> autoship_events shows seq 15 without earning -> missed-earning rule posts it. Topological order: missed earning (step 13) -> earned tier (step 15) -> purchase (step 17, customer). Chain, no parallel ordering. The persona names none of these; tools validate none.

4. FACTOR CARD (handling-time values; baseline = fall-through; figure = result with that factor alone at baseline).
 E missed earning (expected 2478, all-baseline 1367 = the Autoship rule with the held tier's rate): tier rate 2136 (multi-source: Insider held AND 12-month spend 994.78 >= 750 -> 12); apology 2392 (2 entries; near-miss 2026-07-05); milestone 2307 (seq 15); streak 2307 (6; near-miss 2026-03-30); late-posting method 1982 (22 days -> x1.25 on the rate). All factors act on the member's base earn rate, so the Autoship program's earning formula (spend x rate x points_multiplier) is the formula used.
 S earned tier (expected 600, all-baseline 500): method 1100 (re-earning: standard less the 500 tier-upgrade points of 24 months -> 0; the method alternatives are history deduction, spend accrual, or the plain standard bonus); over-achievement 350 (1063.14 >= 1050); fast-track 500 (195 days); cross-program 450 (multi-source); tenure 500.
 P first fee (expected 31.41, all-baseline 59.0): returning-member method 36.2; loyalty 42.01 (VIP AND 65 months); Autoship credit 35.41; shipping-fee credit 32.91; spend credit 33.91 (1063.14); salon credit 34.41.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. member_evt_points_earn.earning_status: status active on 2026-09-14 -> satisfied. One purchase earns once: no earning cites c7916092-76ab-421c-a04e-0e1b55c80aa6. Tier qualification: 2026 net qualifying spend 789.70 >= 750 at the opening (858.06 after the posting). member_tier_change governing policies carry no gate on this subject (policy_scope). Trial: latest fee 2026-02-03 is 245 days before the purchase (< 365) -> no trial. Enrollment bonus: base member_enrollment_and_trials posts enrollment_bonus_points once on the first enrollment of a tier; Tailwise Plus Annual was never held -> 1000 points booked with the purchase (the tool books it). Declared overrides: member earning formula (rate-for-a-missed-earning sentence), bonus-posting sentence (enrollment bonuses kept, earned-tier sum), the tier-upgrade timing fragment (applied the day it is applied), billing fee sentence (fee order).

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Missed earning: autoship_events.c7916092-76ab-421c-a04e-0e1b55c80aa6, key source_event_id; seq 3..14 already earned. Tier: membership e3994121-5ea7-44e8-b42f-ef220a20f879. Purchase: same membership; Plus Monthly fees 2025-11-03..2026-02-03 settled; the rope-toy refund already carries its reversal.

7. WORLD ROWS. points_balance 612 (< 1000, no automatic certificate conversion pending). member_events (27): earnings building the 2026 (789.70) and 12-month (994.78) spend - the 2026-05-09 bed line (155.99) and the 2026-08-17 shipment are what carry 2026 past 750; fees (returning-member method, no trial); tier-upgrade bonuses (re-earning method); certificates (settled). autoship_events seq 3..15 (spend/date/seq/subscription of the missing shipment; six- and three-month counts; 2026-03-30 near-miss). Groom pass + 2 visits (cross-program, salon credit). Orders/events/RMA (earning sources, settled refund+reversal, one shipping fee). Pets.

8. PERSONA. Leona; volunteers only the goal and wants the price first; phone 6175550417, ZIP 02144 (then card 4386 or email); agrees generically if the agent says something must be sorted out first; completes the purchase with the quoted amount and the welcome points figure the agent gives; closes. Never mentions points or tiers.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION. Reads 0-11; writes 13 post_missing_points(points 2478), 15 apply_earned_tier(VIP, 600), 17 (customer) buy_plus_tier(Tailwise Plus Annual, 31.41, enrollment bonus 1000). Verification (authoring run, same machinery as check_compute: replay gold writes before each step with the real tools, evaluate compute, substitute baselines): E 2478 sens [['missed_earning_tier_rate', 2136], ['missed_earning_apology', 2392], ['subscription_milestone', 2307], ['autoship_streak', 2307], ['late_posting_adjustment', 1982]] base 1367; S 600 sens [['upgrade_bonus_method', 1100], ['over_achievement', 350], ['fast_track', 500], ['cross_program', 450], ['membership_tenure', 500]] base 500, without step 13 550; P 31.41 sens [['returning_member_credit', 36.2], ['plus_loyalty_rate', 42.01], ['autoship_credit', 35.41], ['shipping_fee_credit', 32.91], ['plus_spend_credit', 33.91], ['salon_credit', 34.41]] base 59.0, without step 15 37.77.

10. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Rules + records only: fee waits on earned tier; ledger 2026 spend 789.70 earns VIP, Insider held; earned-tier rule; its bonus waits on the latest shipment's earning; seq 15 lacks it; missed-earning rule. Figures 2478, 600, 31.41 - equal to gold. A root-only reading (one write at 37.77) is excluded by the root's own sentence, whose state is false at the opening.

11. REVISION LOG (audit round 1 -> revision 2).
 T0-1/T0-2/T0-5 (chain): symptom - the root's state held at the opening (2026 spend 721.12 earned only Insider); root cause - VIP became earned only through the missed posting. Change - the 2026-05-09 bed line is 155.99 (was 87.41), so the 2026 spend is 789.70 at the opening: VIP is due before any write, the root's edge is false at frozen_time and P2 is reached top-down; P2's sentence now names the most recent charged shipment (what P1 can post). Re-run: P3 31.41 (37.77 without P2); P2 600 with the posting, 550 without (P2 still due).
 T0-3/F-1 (factor label): P2's method now chooses between a history deduction (standard less the tier-upgrade points of 24 months), a spend accrual (standard plus one point per dollar above the threshold) and the plain standard; re-earning world -> 0 vs baseline 500.
 T0-4/F-3 (cross-category): P1's factors now only set the member's base earn rate that the Autoship earning rule multiplies by points_multiplier; the posted entry is that rule's own formula; the program multiplier is read from the shipment's own subscription. Bundle factor (groom) dropped; tier-rate factor added. E 2478 (all-baseline 1367 = the Autoship rule at the held rate).
 F-4: the purchase tool books the enrollment bonus (1000 for a first Tailwise Plus Annual enrollment); P2's override keeps "Enrollment bonuses post with the enrollment that earns them".
 O-6: P2's sentence narrowed to the most recent shipment. O-7: P2 now declares the tier-upgrade timing fragment of member_tier_qualification. Persona: the consent line no longer names points or tiers.
user_scenario:
You are Leona Whitcombe, a hospital pharmacist in Somerville, Massachusetts, calling Tailwise customer care on a Tuesday afternoon between shifts. You have a golden retriever named Biscuit and a cat named Juniper, Biscuit's food comes on Autoship every four weeks, and he has a grooming pass at the salon. You are brisk and friendly and you like to get things done in one call. You open by saying you would like to sign up for Tailwise Plus Annual today, the yearly paid plan, and pay for it with the card you already have on file; you have been meaning to do it since your monthly plan ended earlier this year and a coworker told you the annual plan works out cheaper. You want the annual plan, not the monthly one, and if the agent asks which you want you say Tailwise Plus Annual. You do not know what it will cost you exactly and you ask the agent to tell you the amount before anything is charged.
To find your account you give your mobile number, 6175550417, as soon as the agent asks how to look you up. When the agent asks you to confirm your identity you give your billing ZIP code, 02144, and if they ask for one more detail you give the last four digits of your card, 4386, or your email, leona.whitcombe@mailbox.org. You do not remember the exact date you opened your profile beyond 'spring of 2021'.
You have no idea how the rewards program works behind the scenes and you never bring it up yourself. If the agent tells you that something on your account has to be sorted out first, you say that is fine with you and to go ahead, and if they ask you to confirm before they do it, you confirm. If they mention figures along the way, you simply acknowledge them.
Once the agent tells you the price of the first year of Tailwise Plus Annual, you accept it, because whatever they quote is less than you expected to pay. When the agent hands the purchase over for you to complete yourself, you complete it with your membership, Tailwise Plus Annual, exactly the amount the agent quoted and the welcome points figure the agent tells you, or zero if they tell you none is due. When you see that the purchase went through, you thank the agent and end the call. If the agent instead asks you to do anything else, such as calling back later, you say you would really rather finish it today, and you never suggest any steps yourself.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: apply_earned_tier writes variant_name Pals Rewards VIP (spend_upgrade); loyalty_rate moves from 0.08 to 0.20 and the fee from 37.77 to 31.41.

edges.policy_source: The earned-tier upgrade bonus is not posted until the rewards ledger carries a points earning for the most recent charged Autoship shipment.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (purchase fee <- earned tier <- missed earning); each edge is stated by a prerequisite sentence, so the only legal order is missed earning, earned tier, purchase. No two writes are parallel.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the tier application leaves Pals Rewards Insider: first_charge_usd 31.41 -> 37.77 (loyalty rate 0.20 -> 0.08), and the terminal membership keeps Insider with no tier-upgrade bonus row.

Skipping the missed-earning posting (VIP is still due on the 789.70 already recorded): upgrade_bonus_points 600 -> 550 (net spend 994.78 gives over-achievement 100 instead of 250; fast-track 167 days gives 200 instead of 100), and the terminal ledger lacks the earning row.
